title: Efficient spectral bounds on the chromatic number of Hamming, Johnson, and Kneser graph powers
summary: We investigate spectral lower bounds on the chromatic number $χ$ of Hamming graph powers $H(n, q)^p$, Johnson graph powers $J(n, k)^p$, and Kneser graph powers $K(n, k)^p$ providing the first computationally feasible nontrivial results. While the classical Hoffman bound on $χ$ can, in principle, be applied to any graph, naïve computation requires $O(q^{3n})$ time for $H(n, q)^p$ and $O(({}_nC_k)^3)$ time for both $J(n, k)^p$ and $K(n, k)^p$.
